message: `requests` is synchronous and blocks the event loop. Use `httpx.AsyncClient` (or `httpx` sync in a thread).
Return a response schema, not the ORM model — ORM objects leak columns the API never promised.
Use `Field(default_factory=list)` — a literal mutable default is shared by every instance.
Read configuration through a cached Settings dependency, so it is validated once and overridable in tests.
